title: feat(spec): add next_month, next_quarter and next_30_days date-range presets
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNZcb3qbDCs7tSZcvMtReq8)_

Fixes #30076

Ruling-ref: 6631151570
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n "last_90_days\|last_30_days" -- skills .claude/skills` has 0 hits, and no `skills/**` line lists the preset vocabulary (the dashboards rule only uses `this_quarter` / `this_year` as examples). Nothing is owed to the paused skills lane.
Prior rulings read: date-range-presets,date_range_presets,next_month → 0 hits; none; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack (the card's own ruling 6631151570 is the scope; the tool reads rulings by first-line shape and did not classify it)

ADR-0087: not needed. Nothing is removed or narrowed; the 13 existing windows are byte-identical.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：spec 的日期预设表新增三个往后看的预设：`next_month`（下月）、`next_quarter`（下季度）、`next_30_days`（未来 30 天），服务端 `analytics-date-range` 能解析它们，控制台 10 种语言都有标签。
- 为什么改：卡片 #30076 的裁决 A（「其他全部同意」）。销售预测问的都是往后：下个月、下季度、未来 30 天成交什么；以前只能用会过期的自定义日期。
- 风险与回滚：只加不改，原有 13 个窗口一字不动。下月、下季度的服务端终点没有现成宏，采用席位批准的“重锚定”：同一个解析器从下月第一天再算一次“下月第一天”，不新增宏 token，也不在 core 里做日期运算。回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/date-range-presets.ts`（表和顺序说明）、`packages/core/src/utils/analytics-date-range.ts`（重锚定），以及下面的测量表。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/date-range-presets.test.ts`，然后 build spec 后 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/utils/analytics-date-range.test.ts`（含上海、纽约 DST、查塔姆群岛行）。
- 需要你做的：现在不用做什么，等 CI 和席位验收。

## What changes

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/data/date-range-presets.ts`): `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS` adds `next_month`, `next_quarter`, `next_30_days`, named after `last_30_days`'s spelling. `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS` adds their rows in the inclusive last-day convention (commit 80aef8032), and the closed-window rule now covers the forward presets. Every row is pinned by extent in `date-range-presets.test.ts` (reference day 2026-07-15: August is 31 days, Q4 is 92, `next_30_days` is 31 days like `last_30_days`).
- **Display order** (the filter bar reads the array in order): `this_month, last_month, next_month`, `this_quarter, last_quarter, next_quarter`, then `last_7_days, last_30_days, last_90_days, next_30_days`. Each forward preset sits in the family it extends, after the backward member, so all month windows are found in one place and the rolling group reads backward then forward. The existing 13 keep their relative order; no forward preset opens a group, because the backward windows are the ones most filters ask for.
- **`next_30_days` = today plus the 30 days after it** (`['{today}', '{30_days_from_now}']`), the mirror of `last_30_days` (`['{30_days_ago}', '{today}']`). It opens on today because a row due today is still ahead of a forecast.
- **Server** (`packages/core/src/utils/analytics-date-range.ts`): `PRESET_WINDOW_TOKENS` resolves the three half-open. A bound may now be `{ token, from }`: resolve `from`, then resolve `token` again with the reference instant moved into that day (its noon) in the same zone. `next_month` ends at `{ token: 'next_month_start', from: 'next_month_start' }`, i.e. the month after next; `next_quarter` likewise. The resolver stands at noon of the anchor day, not its first instant: where a zone springs forward at 00:00 on a period's first day (America/Asuncion, 2023-10-01) the day has no midnight, the day-start instant reads as the day before, and the window came out empty (measured: `end === start`). Seat ruling on this card thread: re-anchor, no new macro token (option A of the seat's two).
- **Readers that close over the vocabulary**: the conformance kit (`analytics-date-range-conformance.ts`), `analytics-date-range-closed-vocabulary.test.ts` and lint `validate-preset-comparands.ts` iterate `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS`, so they take the three without edits. objectql `temporal-comparand-door.ts` does not iterate the list: it judges a comparand by the field's declared type, so a new preset name needs nothing there (its test passes unchanged). Only prose counts ("the 13 declared names", "each of the thirteen") were made count-free.
- **ui/** (seat-lifted, exactly these): the three labels in all 10 packs under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/` (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh; zh-Hant has no pack yet, phase 2 of #29428, so none is created); the three English defaults in `filter-builder.tsx`'s label table (measured: without them the 29115 test renders the raw keys `dashboard.filters.range.next_month`, 4 cases red); `next_month_end` and `next_quarter_end` in the client resolver `ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts` (spec tokens the client did not resolve; without them the console lowers 下月 to `['2026-08-01', '{next_month_end}']`); and the two pins that counted 13 (`dashboard-filters.presetWindows-29116.test.ts`, `filter-builder-relative-dates-29115.test.tsx`).
- **`packages/verify`** (`dashboard-window.ts`, a reader of `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS`): its fixture rows were written only on days up to today, so the three forward windows selected no rows and 5 of 15 cases in `dashboard-window.test.ts` went red. A window whose last day is after today now also writes its own future edges; the days written for the 13 existing presets are unchanged (15/15 green).
- **Pins**: `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.test.ts` counted 13 presets and 14 default ranges; now 16 and 17. The 29116 test's compareTo case runs on the 13 retired presets only, with a comment naming #30140.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` preset table; stale "13 presets" / "never after today" prose in `packages/verify/README.md` and `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`; the preset list in `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`; `content/docs/references/**` regenerated by `gen:docs`; the `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json` item `api-backend.date-range-preset-matrix` widened to 16 variants (revision 3, `enumSource.expect: 16`).

## Measurement: preset → spec window → server window → resolves?

Reference: spec on 2026-07-15 (UTC days); server on `now` 2026-09-09T12:34:56.789Z unless noted. Server windows are `[start, end)` instants.

| preset | spec window (inclusive, `$between`) | server half-open tokens | server window | resolves? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `next_month` | `['{next_month_start}', '{next_month_end}']` → 2026-08-01 … 2026-08-31 | `next_month_start` → `next_month_start` re-anchored on `next_month_start` | 2026-10-01T00:00Z → 2026-11-01T00:00Z | yes, by re-anchoring (no `month_after_next_start` token exists; `PERIOD_RE` stops at `next_`) |
| `next_quarter` | `['{next_quarter_start}', '{next_quarter_end}']` → 2026-10-01 … 2026-12-31 | `next_quarter_start` → `next_quarter_start` re-anchored on `next_quarter_start` | 2026-10-01T00:00Z → 2027-01-01T00:00Z | yes, by re-anchoring |
| `next_30_days` | `['{today}', '{30_days_from_now}']` → 2026-07-15 … 2026-08-14 | `today` → `31_days_from_now` | 2026-09-09T00:00Z → 2026-10-10T00:00Z | yes, directly (parametric days resolve to a calendar day) |

Timezone and DST rows pinned in `analytics-date-range.test.ts` (`#30076` block):

| preset | now | zone | window | why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `next_month` | 2026-01-31T20:00Z | Asia/Shanghai | 2026-02-28T16:00Z → 2026-03-31T16:00Z | the Shanghai day is already Feb 1, so next month is March |
| `next_month` | 2026-01-31T20:00Z | UTC | 2026-02-01T00:00Z → 2026-03-01T00:00Z | control |
| `next_month` | 2026-10-15T12:00Z | America/New_York | 2026-11-01T04:00Z → 2026-12-01T05:00Z | DST ends Nov 1: start EDT, end EST |
| `next_quarter` | 2026-12-10T12:00Z | America/New_York | 2027-01-01T05:00Z → 2027-04-01T04:00Z | year rollover, EST start, EDT end |
| `next_30_days` | 2026-10-20T12:00Z | America/New_York | 2026-10-20T04:00Z → 2026-11-20T05:00Z | window crosses DST end |
| `next_month` | 2026-03-15T00:00Z | Pacific/Chatham | 2026-03-31T10:15Z → 2026-04-30T11:15Z | +13:45 then +12:45, non-whole-hour |
| `next_month` | 2023-09-15T12:00Z | America/Asuncion | 2023-10-01T03:00Z → 2023-11-01T03:00Z | springs forward at 00:00 on Oct 1; a midnight anchor gave an empty window |
| `next_quarter` | 2023-08-15T12:00Z | America/Asuncion | 2023-10-01T03:00Z → 2024-01-01T03:00Z | the quarter opens on the gap day |

The existing `#17341` sweep (every preset, 8 instants × 4 zones) also holds each new end to "the day after the spec's inclusive last day", and the tiling test now includes `this_month → next_month` and `this_quarter → next_quarter`.

## UI reader measurement

| reader | reads the spec table? | result |
|---|---|---|
| `ui/packages/core/src/utils/dashboard-filters.ts` | yes: imports `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS` and lowers through `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS` | takes the three with no edit |
| `ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx` | yes: `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS.map(...)` for options and label keys | takes the three; its English defaults table needed the three rows |
| `ui/packages/core/src/utils/date-macros.ts` (client resolver) | no: its own token table | lacked `next_month_end` / `next_quarter_end`; added here. `next_week_end` and `next_year_end` are still missing: follow-up #30134 |
| `ui/packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts:595-610` | no: a hand-kept union | already lists `next_month`, `next_quarter`, `next_30_days` (plus undeclared `next_year`, `next_7_days`, `next_90_days`); not edited |

No `domain:ui` follow-up is needed for the preset list itself: both readers derive from the spec.

## Follow-ups

- #30134 (`domain:ui`, p3): the console's client resolver leaves `{next_week_end}` and `{next_year_end}` unresolved.
- #30140 (`domain:ui`, p2): dashboard `compareTo` on a forward preset compares the window with itself. `compare-to.ts` is not touched here.
